applicability: Valid for integer upper_bound in [2, 10000000]; rejects booleans, non-integers, missing keys, and out-of-range values. Returns the largest n < upper_bound whose base-10 digit sum equals its base-2 popcount. For upper_bound=1000 this directly solves the stated problem. Runtime is O(upper_bound * log upper_bound), which is practical within the stated bound.
description: Exhaustively searches integers from upper_bound-1 down to 1, computing the decimal digit sum and binary popcount of each, and returns the first (largest) integer for which the two costs are equal. The search is complete and deterministic; the only assumption is that the intended domain is positive integers strictly below upper_bound, matching the source problem with upper_bound=1000.
